title: Explosion prevention.
officialText: For rooms or spaces containing appliances operating with gas pressure at or above 15 psig (103.4 kPa gauge) and less than 125 psig (861.8 kPa gauge), explosion prevention systems shall be provided in accordance with NFPA 69.
